package controller

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strconv"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/util/logging"
)

var oberthWIFCapture func(*corev1.Pod)

func TestOberthWIFControllerCapture(t *testing.T) {
 dir:=os.Getenv("OBERTH_WIF_PROOF_DIR");require.NotEmpty(t,dir)
 for _,shape:=range []string{"image-writer","image-reader","chart-writer","script","helpers","vault","sibling"} {
  for _,automount:=range []bool{false,true} {
   name:=shape+"-sa-"+strconv.FormatBool(automount)
   t.Run(name,func(t *testing.T){
    data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+"-workflow.json"));require.NoError(t,err)
    var wf wfv1.Workflow;require.NoError(t,json.Unmarshal(data,&wf));wf.UID="wif-controller-fixture"
    sa:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace},AutomountServiceAccountToken:ptr.To(automount)}
    executor:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.Executor.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace},Secrets:[]corev1.ObjectReference{{Name:"executor-token-fixture"}}}
    ctx:=logging.TestContext(t.Context());cancel,controller:=newController(ctx,&wf,sa,executor);defer cancel()
    write:=func(kind string,v any){b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(v,"","  ");require.NoError(t,e);require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,name+"-"+kind+".json"),b,0600))}
    captures:=0;oberthWIFCapture=func(pod *corev1.Pod){captures++;write("before-patch",pod)};defer func(){oberthWIFCapture=nil}()
    woc:=newWorkflowOperationCtx(ctx,&wf,controller);woc.operate(ctx)
    pods,err:=controller.kubeclientset.CoreV1().Pods(wf.Namespace).List(ctx,metav1.ListOptions{});require.NoError(t,err)
    require.Len(t,pods.Items,1,"phase=%s message=%s nodes=%+v",woc.wf.Status.Phase,woc.wf.Status.Message,woc.wf.Status.Nodes);require.Equal(t,1,captures)
    pod:=&pods.Items[0];write("submitted",pod)
    require.NotNil(t,pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken);require.False(t,*pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken)
    for _,c:=range append(pod.Spec.Containers,pod.Spec.InitContainers...) {
     hasWIF:=false
     for _,m:=range c.VolumeMounts {
      if m.Name=="oberth-release-wif" {hasWIF=true;require.Equal(t,"main",c.Name);require.NotEqual(t,"sibling",shape);require.True(t,m.ReadOnly)}
      if c.Name!="main" {require.NotEqual(t,"oberth-release-token",m.Name);require.NotEqual(t,"oberth-secrets",m.Name)}
      if c.Name!="init"&&c.Name!="wait" {require.NotEqual(t,"exec-sa-token",m.Name)}
     }
     if c.Name=="main" {require.Equal(t,shape!="sibling",hasWIF)}
    }
   })
  }
 }
}
